name: Lantern AI
long_description:
Lantern is the agentic recruiting platform for enterprise.

Lantern runs on: 
(1) World People Model, a live talent graph of a billion professionals that knows who’s exceptional, reachable, and about to move
(2) Company Hiring Model, which learns your taste from every hiring decision you’ve ever made

Together, our agents plug into your existing systems and run the whole workflow: sourcing, application review, AI interviews, meeting intelligence, and analytics, under universal context. 

Lantern also launched OpenRouter for People (people.lantern.md), an agent-native infrastructure to empower agents to find, research, outreach to anyone in the world.

launches.title: Lantern: Agentic Recruiting Platform for the Future 🎃
launches.tagline: Connected agents that source, screen and coordinate hiring, learning from every interview and decision
launches.body:
**_We are killing Workday, SuccessFactors and Ashby_**

**TL;DR:** Lantern is an agentic recruiting platform. It runs on a world model of a billion professionals and a model of your own company's hiring taste, and its connected agents source, review applications, run interviews, schedule and report. 

**We processed 2M+ candidates for companies like [Crypto.com](http://Crypto.com), Hyatt, Baker McKenzie and Eight Sleep**. Try it at [lantern.md](http://lantern.md).

### <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XdEasqnED-M>

**Your hiring software knows nothing about the outside world and your company**

Workday, SuccessFactors and Ashby are systems of record. They don’t know who’s ready for a new job, where to find great people, or what makes someone right for your team. Recruiters carry that in their heads and browser tabs. When they leave, that knowledge leaves too.

**Lantern runs on two models:** 

**The world people model.** A talent map across a billion professionals, with career signals tracked live: role changes, launches, team moves, who is hiring. It knows talent density by company and who is genuinely exceptional.

**Your hiring model.** Built from your context, your interview notes and your whole hiring history. Every interview and every offer teaches it what your team values.

### **One brain, connected team of agents**

1. **Kickoff.** Lantern sits in on the kickoff call between the hiring manager and the recruiter, learns what the team values, and checks it against who the company has hired and rejected before.
2. **Sourcing.** With that taste, Lantern proactively starts sourcing: it searches a billion professionals, builds the shortlist, and drafts outreach for the recruiter to approve.
3. **Screening.** When candidates apply or reply, the same hiring context drives application review and the AI interviews, and Lantern books the next rounds around everyone’s calendars.
4. **Learning.** After every debrief and interview, the sourcing and screening criteria update, so the next search starts smarter than the last.
5. **Analytics.** Ask Lantern anything about your hiring pipeline without digging through dashboards or exporting data

Sourcing. Application review. AI interviews. Meeting intelligence. Complex scheduling. Analytics. All of it queryable from Slack and MCP. 

Teams can start with Lantern on top of their existing ATS, or replace it entirely. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125189&key=user_uploads/3085542/eb4d4756-1bcd-4924-812c-be581f833257)

Thomas closed $2M in sales with clients including L’Oréal, Accenture, and IBM in our previous startups. Previously worked at Morgan Stanley and HSBC. 3M Linkedin Impressions in the last 90 days.
